content: @supabase/ssr v0.12.x is the current package for Next.js SSR auth (replaces deprecated @supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs). Create three client variants: browser client (createBrowserClient, client components), server client (createServerClient with cookies from next/headers, Server Components/Actions/Route Handlers), and middleware client (createServerClient inside middleware.ts using request/response cookie adapters) to refresh the auth token on every request since Server Components cannot write cookies.
